headline: Cultural Resources Commission

meeting.summary: The commission heard Lahaina Royal Complex and Pāʻia project presentations and voted to answer a Cost of Government Commission report.
meeting.recap: The vice chair stepped aside from the first item because of her job with the project's archaeology firm.[[0:03:43]] The commission heard a request for input on a cultural impact assessment (a study of effects on cultural practices) for a mixed-use project in Pāʻia town.[[0:28:11]] One project area is proposed for multifamily housing to help meet affordable housing needs.[[0:33:18]] The vice chair said a Cost of Government Commission report made four recommendations for this commission.[[0:48:47]] The county's boards and commissions liaison said she thinks no one is on the applicant list for this commission right now.[[2:04:14]] The vice chair moved to send a response on the report to the Cost of Government Commission, with a copy to the County Council.[[2:31:23]] The motion passed with no objections.[[2:39:32]] Staff said proposed federal rule changes would let federal agencies decide whether to do any consultation under Section 106.[[2:42:17]] Staff reported five HDX applications approved by staff since April, and five more in review.[[2:54:02]] The vice chair said she disagrees with staff approving HDXs because it skips commission review and public testimony.[[2:58:05]]
decided: The chair moved the Pāʻia consultation item ahead of the report discussion with no objections.
meeting.next: The archaeologist said she will ask the project developer about managed retreat from the shoreline. Staff agreed to post lists of approved and in-review HDXs for future meetings.
